messages.author: Vlad
messages.body:
Dear Amber developers,
We found out that test cases
*$AMBERHOME/test/phmd_remd/implicit/Run.phmdremd *and
*$AMBERHOME/test/rxsgld_4rep* always fail using different compilers and
platforms. So, either the test cases are outdated or a program code is
broken.
A test *$AMBERHOME/test/hrem_random_partner/Run.hremd* uses a keyword
"*-remrandompartner*'. The option "*-remrandompartner*" is not defined
in Amber23.
It's only defined in Amber24 in $AMBERHOME/src/pmemd/src/get_cmdline.F90
Best, Vlad
